title: Heavy!
text: Heavy!. I love these thermal mugs. They keep things cold for hours. The only problem I have with this one is that it weights way too much. If someone drops it on their foot...broken toes for sure!

product_metadata.title: Ezprogear 40 oz 2 Pack Coffee Mug Stainless Steel Double Wall Ice Cup Vacuum Insulated Tumbler with Handle and Lid (Black+RoseGold)
features: Simple design, Elegant look 40 oz Ezprogear’s Stainless Steel tumbler with various colors to pick. This powder coated tumbler is a perfect for your carry-on drink whether its indoor or outdoor. Comfortable attached handle with full loop design and easy to grip while you enjoy your drink. This 40 oz mug does not fit vehicle’s cup holder.

Made from high quality 304 18/8 food grade stainless steel, strong and durable make the tumbler is unbreakable for long time use. Rust resistant and easy-reach to clean by hand. Come with removable sliding Lid to provide maximum spill resistance which means no more splashes worry.

This 40 oz mug is design with vacuum insulated technology for known as heat preservation to keep your hot and cold beverage for many hours longer than regular cup. The double Wall is design for Sweat-Free and comfortable to hold on hand.

We offer the exclusive bundle, with this package you’ll get 2x 40 oz tumbler, 2x Sliding lids, 4x 8mm (0.31 inch) wide straw and 2x brush for cleaning your straw. You can choose many vibrant colors we carry that will surely fit every single personality.
This 40 oz mug does not fit car holder. The bottom diameter is 3.93 Inch.
